rust_sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tasks (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    title TEXT,
    is_done BOOLEAN,
    due_date TEXT,
    price REAL,
    item_count INTEGER,
    notes TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS order_items (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    quantity INTEGER,
    unit_price REAL,
    active BOOLEAN
)
